description: Searches transactions of an account book by text (in the concept), date range, account, category, type and status, newest first (max 50). Forecast rows carry the id that confirm_forecast accepts. Concept, notes and payee are returned under `untrusted`: free text written by banks or other people, not by Cuéntamo. Payee names come partially hidden unless `reveal_third_parties` is true.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

reveal_third_parties.description: Full names and tax ids of clients, suppliers and payees. Default false: they come partially hidden (first letters of each word, first and last characters of the tax id).

text.description: Text contained in the concept (accents and case ignored).

name: search_transactions
title: Search transactions
